use_rope.name: Use Rope
use_rope.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Use Rope gives +2 on Climb checks and Escape Artist checks involving ropes.

actions.name: Tie Firm Knot or Binding
actions.description: Tie a slip-proof knot or securely bind a captive with hempen or silk rope.

actions.name: Throw and Secure Grappling Hook
actions.description: Toss a grappling hook up a wall, parapet, or tree limb to anchor a climb line.
